title: Craft/Notion Docs
content: Apply Craft aesthetic with document editing feel. Block-based content structure. Beautiful typography and spacing. Cover images and icons. Nested pages and folders. Real-time collaboration. Export options. Daily notes and templates. Backlinks and references. Markdown support. Focus mode.

variants.simple: Create document editor with blocks, beautiful typography, and collaboration.
variants.detailed: Apply Craft aesthetic with document editing feel. Block-based content structure. Beautiful typography and spacing. Cover images and icons. Nested pages and folders. Real-time collaboration. Export options. Daily notes and templates. Backlinks and references. Markdown support. Focus mode.
variants.advanced: Apply Craft aesthetic with document patterns. Editor: clean canvas, blocks with hover handles. Typography: excellent defaults, custom fonts (serif/sans toggle), proper hierarchy. Blocks: paragraph, headings (1-3), lists (bullet, number, toggle, checkbox), quotes, code, callouts, images, embeds. Block handles: left margin, drag to reorder, click for menu, / command. Cover: header image with gradient fade, reposition. Icon: emoji or custom image as page icon. Pages: nested in sidebar, drag to organize, favorites section. Folders: group pages, expand/collapse. Templates: starter templates, user-created templates. Daily notes: calendar-linked, quick entry. Collaboration: cursors, comments, suggestions mode. Export: PDF, Markdown, Word, with styling options. Backlinks: see pages that link to current page. Mentions: [[Page Name]] linking, autocomplete. Focus: full screen mode, typewriter scrolling. Cards: link cards with preview, inline expansion. Tables: block-based tables, formula support. Sync: real-time, conflict resolution, offline support. Mobile: responsive, touch-friendly block editing. Search: full text, filter by type, recent. Share: public links, password protect, expiry. Themes: light, dark, sepia, custom.
